parameters.name: nextToken
parameters.description: The token for keyset pagination. Omit this parameter for the first page. For subsequent pages, use the `nextToken` value from the previous response.

parameters.name: orderBy
parameters.description: The property to sort the results by. For consistent iteration, use the `id` property.

parameters.name: pagination
parameters.description: The pagination method. Currently, only `keyset` pagination is supported.

parameters.name: perPage
parameters.description: The maximum number of items to return per page.

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: The sort order. Valid values: `asc` (ascending) and `desc` (descending). Use ascending order for consistent iteration.
